subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “They found a loose wire and fixed it.”?
options: After asking around, they found a third blue box in Lily's bag.
When Ruby cleaned her father's desk, she found an old movie ticket.
Then they replaced the wheel with one from an old toy box.
His sister asked why he wanted an old toy.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「After asking around, they found a third blue box in Lily's bag.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「When Ruby cleaned her father's desk, she found an old movie ticket.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「They found a loose wire and fixed it. Then they replaced the wheel with one from an old toy box.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「His sister asked why he wanted an old toy.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「They found a loose wire and fixed it. Then they replaced the wheel with one from an old toy box.」，答案為「Then they replaced the wheel with one from an old toy box.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Then they replaced the wheel with one from an old toy box.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
